supporting_observations.claim: WS-EBROOKS-01 made repeated proxy CONNECT attempts to update.stockpilot.co at roughly five-minute intervals from 13:41 through 14:11 UTC; the 13:51 attempt received a 504, while the other listed attempts succeeded. The alerted destination is update.stockpilot.co, whereas the inventory identifies the approved StockPilot update host as update.stockpilot.com.

The network activity is associated with stockpilotupd.exe running from Eli Brooks's AppData\Local\StockPilot directory, not the inventory-listed approved path C:\Program Files\StockPilot\stockpilotupd.exe.

The repeated StockPilot-named process, unexpected executable location, and destination-domain mismatch together support treating the alerted activity as malicious rather than as the approved StockPilot updater.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show CONNECT tunnels and metadata, but the supplied evidence does not show the HTTPS request contents or downloaded payload.
The supplied process records do not establish the executable's signature, hash, provenance, or reputation.
The stated winsec and Sysmon collection outage is for WS-RMOSS-01, not WS-EBROOKS-01; the supplied coverage information lists the alerted host's relevant sensors as operational.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish who controls update.stockpilot.co or whether it is malicious infrastructure.
The evidence does not establish whether the AppData executable is an unauthorized or modified binary, or a legitimate but unrecorded StockPilot installation.
The evidence does not show what data, if any, was sent or received through the HTTPS tunnels.
additional_evidence_needed: Acquire and examine the AppData StockPilot executable; record its hash, signature, file metadata, and origin, and compare it with the approved StockPilot binary.
Validate update.stockpilot.co with the StockPilot vendor and review domain registration, DNS resolution, certificate, and proxy/TLS details.
Review endpoint and proxy records for the full request and response details, including any files downloaded by this process.
unrelated_findings: DropboxUpdate.exe ran as SYSTEM on WS-EBROOKS-01; Dropbox is not listed as approved. Review separately. (T205-00091, T205-00092)

Cisco AnyConnect's UI launched on WS-EBROOKS-01 despite the inventory stating there is no VPN and remote administration is only done from WS-KITO-01. Review separately; this is not used to assess the alerted StockPilot connections. (T205-00177, T205-00178, T205-00179)
